newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez sees 500 mln Fr cap gain Facto sale.
newsitem.headline: Suez sees 500 mln Fr cap gain Facto sale.

text.p: French holding company Compagnie de Suez said on Wednesday it expected a capital gain of more than 500 million francs in its 1997 accounts as a result of a deal to sell its Facto Holdings stake to Heller International Group.
Suez said in a statement it agreed to sell the 50 percent stake it had held in the 50/50 Facto venture with Heller since 1996 and that Heller would now get total control.
The deal fitted with Suez's strategy of focusing on services to local authorities and financial services to private indivduals, it said.
"It will result in a consolidated capital gain of more than 500 million francs in the 1997 accounts," the statement said.
